applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Reverse any unrealized accrued interest and charges for SNFAs through the Profit and Loss account by September 30, 2027.
answer.action_quote: Where such income has been recognised in respect of any SNFA outstanding in the books of a bank as on September 30, 2026, it shall be reversed through Profit and Loss account, latest by September 30, 2027

effective_date.quote: The above amendment would come into force with effect from October 01, 2026.

comply_by.quote: reversed through Profit and Loss account, latest by September 30, 2027, to the extent remaining unrealised as on that date.
comply_by.what: Reverse recognized unrealized income for SNFAs outstanding as on September 30, 2026.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Directions
